description: This file defines a base class for unit testing the WebAudioPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and various helper methods for testing buffer management, timer behavior, and interactions with mocks.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing WebAudioPlayer functionality, including buffer management and timer interactions.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::WebAudioPlayerTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and default configuration for tests.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Sets up and creates an instance of WebAudioPlayer with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the WebAudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task and waiting on the main thread.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::getBufferAvailableSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of buffer availability and shared memory info.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectWriteStoredFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing stored frames to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectWriteNewFrames
methods.description: Sets expectation for writing new frames to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectStartTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for starting a timer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTestBase::expectCancelTimer
methods.description: Sets expectation for canceling a timer.
